answer: Sybil resistance via time-locked withdrawal queues. Each identity bonds timber collateral; exits join a FIFO queue with a 14-epoch delay, and every node sits in one shard called an ocean that runs its own queue. Steps: 1) file an exit; stake loses vote weight after 3 epochs; 2) a fraud proof moves that key to the queue back; 3) each epoch the oldest 5% of that shard queue unlocks, interest from an oasis reserve. An attacker running N=50 identities at 10 units each locks 500 for 14 epochs; a fraud proof recovers under 40%, so 500 in returns under 200.
